summary: All three phases delivered their objectives. Phase-01 edited the correct gate-profile test file (the plan named a non-existent path) and made an unplanned but necessary edit to the init-wizard integration test due to the new required `output` field on encoded gate steps. Phase-02 touched one additional unplanned test file (`reportBuilders.test.ts`) solely to satisfy the new required `diagnostics` field on `GateFailedError`. Phase-03 had no deviations at all. Every deviation was justified by a real constraint and documented in the handoff.

findings.message: Plan named `tests/unit/schemas/gateProfile.test.ts` as a planned edit; that path does not exist. The phase correctly edited `tests/unit/gateProfile.test.ts` instead. The reconciliation lists the planned path as missing and the actual path as unplanned — this is a plan naming error, not an execution gap.

`tests/integration/initWizard.test.ts` was unplanned but required edits because the now-required `output` field on encoded gate steps broke deep-equality assertions in that test. The fix was additive (`output: "log"` added to expected objects) with no behaviour change.

`tests/unit/telemetry/reportBuilders.test.ts` was unplanned. It constructs a `GateFailedError` literal; the now-required `diagnostics` field caused a typecheck failure. Adding `diagnostics: []` is a mechanical conformance fix with no behaviour change.

The plan's `buildFixPrompt` signature omitted `logPath`, but the plan body requires `Full output: <logPath>` in the diagnostics branch. Adding `logPath` to `BuildFixPromptInput` is the only correct implementation; not scope creep.

attentionPoints: The reconciliation records `tests/unit/schemas/gateProfile.test.ts` as missing (not touched in phase-01). This is a plan naming error — the correct file `tests/unit/gateProfile.test.ts` was edited. Future plans should use the correct path.

All configured gates passed at the end of phase-03 (`pnpm check:full` equivalents: format, typecheck, test:type, lint, format:check, test, knip, audit:architecture, gen:model-catalog --check, build, deno:smoke, deno:smoke-binary).
